summary: The build.sh source web-launcher feature is implemented, verified, security-reviewed, release-documented, and archived. A new engineer can run ./build.sh from the source checkout to prepare and open the existing AppForge-LLM v4 web UI, or run the skip-mode smoke command for deterministic local verification.
delivered: Executable repository-root build.sh launcher with --help, --check, --no-open, and --smoke modes.
Python setup path in build.sh using uv sync --extra dev when available, with python3 venv/pip fallback.
Frontend setup path in build.sh that installs frontend dependencies only when frontend/node_modules is missing and rebuilds packaged FastAPI web assets.
Normal launcher path delegating to .venv/bin/appforge web with 127.0.0.1:8787 defaults and browser opening enabled by default.
Prepared-workspace smoke path that starts appforge web without browser opening, probes /api/health and /, then stops only the launcher-owned server PID.
Optional llm_bridge reuse/startup path gated by APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1, with APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE=1 as an escape hatch.
README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md updates presenting ./build.sh as the easiest source UI path while preserving existing CLI/frontend commands.
AppForge quality-command detector fix: Python quality commands now use sys.executable so run_tests and run_build gates execute in the active interpreter even when python is not on PATH.
Regression coverage in tests/test_tools.py for PATH-empty Python quality command detection.
quickstart: Optional bridge path: APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge ./build.sh, or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1 ./build.sh
Manual source path remains: python -m venv .venv; source .venv/bin/activate; python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'; npm --prefix frontend install; npm --prefix frontend run build; appforge web
Core verification: bash -n build.sh; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q; npm --prefix frontend run typecheck; npm --prefix frontend run build

.appforge/artifacts/workflow_spec.json defines WF-001 through WF-007 for argument parsing, Python/frontend setup, optional bridge startup, normal web launch, smoke checks, and docs.

.appforge/artifacts/memory_spec.json defines MEM-001 through MEM-007 for process-local launcher state, dependency readiness, packaged web assets, optional bridge runtime, web runtime, smoke status, and documentation.
.appforge/artifacts/loop_spec.json defines LOOP-001 through LOOP-006 for bounded setup, bridge, foreground web, smoke, and verification loops.
.appforge/artifacts/change_plan.json records the accepted implementation plan and rollback.
Primary source references: build.sh, README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, CHANGELOG.md, appforge/tooling/detection.py, tests/test_tools.py, appforge/cli.py, appforge/web.py, frontend/vite.config.ts.
verification_reference: .appforge/artifacts/implementation_report.json documents the launcher implementation decisions and initial checks.
.appforge/artifacts/verification_report.json contains the full verification record, including the initial AppForge gate failure and detector fix.
.appforge/artifacts/security_report.json contains the threat model, secret scan result, dependency audit limitation, and residual risks.
.appforge/artifacts/release_report.json contains build artifacts, hashes, release checks, known issues, and rollback.

operations_reference: APPFORGE_WEB_HOST controls build.sh/appforge web bind host and defaults to 127.0.0.1.
APPFORGE_WEB_PORT controls build.sh/appforge web bind port and defaults to 8787.
APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 reuses current packaged web assets.
APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1 or APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge requests bridge reuse/startup.
APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE=1 leaves bridge management to another terminal/process.
APPFORGE_SMOKE_TIMEOUT and APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT bound health polling.
Launcher-owned bridge logs go to APPFORGE_DATA_DIR or .appforge-web by default; this runtime directory is ignored and excluded from source archives.
open_items: First-run dependency downloads were not exercised because network downloads are disabled in this AppForge runner.
Online dependency audit was not performed for the same network policy reason.
generate_sbom currently inventories root manifests only and does not enumerate nested frontend or llm_bridge npm dependencies.
Setuptools emits existing project.license/classifier deprecation warnings during python -m build; build succeeds, but license metadata should be modernized before the 2027-Feb-18 setuptools deadline.
Launcher-owned llm_bridge startup was not tested with live provider credentials; provider-backed use still depends on Bun, bridge dependencies, and user/provider configuration.
next_steps: Run ./build.sh from a clean network-approved source checkout to exercise first-run uv/pip/npm preparation.
Run an online dependency audit in an environment where network access is approved.
Extend AppForge SBOM generation to inspect nested frontend/package.json and llm_bridge/package.json manifests.
Modernize pyproject.toml license metadata to remove setuptools deprecation warnings.
Optionally add shell unit tests or a small Bats-style harness for build.sh argument parsing if the launcher grows.
